name: Atlassian MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to search and retrieve data from Jira and Confluence directly within MCP-compatible IDEs. It provides tools for managing Jira tickets and Confluence pages using OAuth 2.0 authentication and Hexagonal Architecture.
